content:
Mommy. Can I have a cat?
A cat? Why do you want one, Margaret?
My friend Betty has one.
She has a cat?
Yes, and her cat is so cute.
You have to take care of it.
I know, mom. I'll feed it every day.
Okay, Margaret. You'll have a cat.
